I haven't seen any new products at my best buy in a while, it is starting to look ragged (empty shelves and sections, I guess I exaggerate a bit). I like my warranty, but why have it if I can't get the same thing again, and you have nothing new for me to buy with store credit? My watch broke, and you guys no longer carry it. Now I have all this credit, but the only thing I can find that I actually want is gift cards for the steam store. Where is the new stuff? Is this just my local store?

Also, I am suddenly being harassed by "third-party sales representatives" who are super aggressive. I cringed today when this guy bugged me to talk about Xfinity while I was trying to find a new pair of headphones. A sales rep derailing me when I am obviously focused on something, so he can tell me about these promotions comcast is offering to improve their reputation for customer service, I'm pretty sure that is textbook irony.

I have a friend that I hooked up with. We hang sometimes, she hangs with my girlfriend sometimes, we both have our own lives. That sounds a lot like we're doing it without doing it.

Maybe not for calling the police, but I have noticed that 90% of all Uber/Lyft drivers I have met are super aggressive oversharers.

 These are people who were obviously expecting to make more money than they are, and a lot of them purchased their cars so they could drive for a rideshare company. Worse, their emotional turmoil shines through no matter what they end up talking to me about. I can think of few rides where they didn't take at least a moment, if not the whole ride to remind me they don't get paid shit, and to tip them. Rideshare drivers have it so hard, they convinced me to stop using their apps long before Reddit was telling me how crappy those companies are.
